title: Strict matched full-collection controls and frozen final evaluation
question: How do the final exact pruned GPU scorers compare with the stronger compact GPUSparse and CPU-BMP controls under a fresh matched full-collection protocol, and do the frozen choices generalize to heldout queries?
hypothesis: No assumed speed gap; all supported systems return identical canonical answers
motivation: Close genuine comparison gaps revealed by independent audit and protect final evaluation from calibration tuning
declared_changes: CPU PISA cap32 text is prepared once outside timer; duplicates counted exactly, unsupported >32 weights or >128 distinct terms rejected
CPU fresh cursors and canonical retrieval remain timed; ordered numeric-ID/score mapping and allocation included; TREC formatting moved outside timing
Deterministic lexical token order replaces randomized HashMap traversal, disclosed and correctness checked
No change to underlying BMP pruning, arithmetic, eligibility or canonical tie selection
Complete expected runtime rather than subset match; fixed resource eligibility and original-ID preflight; same algorithm bytes for existing pruned/exhaustive/compact scorers
input_manifest: Pinned full-collection parent hashes in protocol/runtime templates; exact deployment manifest recorded before execution
timing_boundary: Resident parsed cap32 term/weight pairs through fresh per-query preparation/cursors, all retrieval/selection/transfers, ordered original numeric-ID/score top-k in host memory. Exclude file decoding, index load, domain verification, and textual result formatting consistently. Disclose each implementation-specific operation.
correctness_rule: All-document eligibility and numeric-ID ties; exact uint8 weights and cap32 queries
Independent CPU uint64 oracle for every query, all rounds/processes
Fresh full-score/schedule checks and existing synthetic boundary/tie/large-score fixtures
Complete actual-runtime config/behavior match before measured compute through scripts/research.py run
Deliberate pre-compute runtime rejection checks for every new adapter path

measurement_and_analysis_plan.per_query: Median of 20 rounds per process and query
measurement_and_analysis_plan.paired: Geometric mean query-time ratios paired by process block and query
measurement_and_analysis_plan.uncertainty: 10000 crossed process/query bootstrap draws, fixed seed 20261118; conditional on shared-host session
descriptive: own sampled memory and modeled allocations
measurement_and_analysis_plan.controls: All five on full collection. Primary GPU prunets-W256 / compact and prunets-W256 / BMP. Secondary W1024 contrasts, exhaustive control, component controls retained from audited calibration studies. No cross-session median division as a matched claim.

success_rule: Complete correctness and fifteen eligible fresh timing processes, independent analysis/claim-time review; then freeze and evaluate
failure_rule: Preserve every failure; separately review repairs, max3 technical repairs; resource attempts bounded independently
next_if_negative: Retain null/slower outcome without tuning on heldout queries
